narrative: Email warning that your exam hall ticket will be revoked.

message.body: URGENT: Discrepancy found in your admit card photo. Upload corrected photo at http://admitcard-fix-portal.org within 20 minutes or hall ticket will be cancelled.

evidence.label: Official Examination Controller Portal
evidence.value: Admit card status shows Valid & Verified; no photo correction notice listed.

consequence_text.safe: You verified your hall ticket on the official exam portal and confirmed it was valid.
consequence_text.unsafe: Submitting details on lookalike portals compromises your personal credentials.

teaching_point: Transfer strategy: Apply verification strategies across academic and exam portals when faced with urgent revocation threats.
